name: The Crystal Cocoon Nursery
description: A hidden grove where countless crystal cocoons hang from tree branches, each containing a softly glowing, sleeping creature made of light and mist.
prompt: A magical and serene scene of a hidden forest grove at twilight. Hundreds of large, faceted crystal cocoons of various sizes hang from the branches of ancient trees, catching the last light of the setting sun and the first light of the moon. Inside each cocoon, a softly glowing creature made of pure light and mist sleeps peacefully—some look like fawns, others like birds or dragons. The glow from within the cocoons casts beautiful, colorful reflections on the forest floor, covered in soft moss and ferns. Fireflies drift lazily through the air. The atmosphere is peaceful, protective, and full of new beginnings. Highly detailed fantasy digital art with a focus on light and transparency.
caption: Guarding the next generation of wonders, cradled in crystal and starlight. What dream is stirring inside? 💎🌙
